description: This file defines the 'SandboxTokenParser' class responsible for parsing the 'sandbox' tag in Twig templates. It enforces that only include nodes are allowed within a sandboxed section, and handles parsing logic related to the sandbox block.

classes.name: SandboxTokenParser
classes.description: Final class that extends AbstractTokenParser to parse the 'sandbox' tags within Twig templates, ensuring proper encapsulation and validation within sandbox sections.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'sandbox' block, verifies allowed nodes, and returns a SandboxNode. Handles deprecation warning for the 'sandbox' tag.

methods.name: decideBlockEnd
methods.description: Checks if the current token indicates the end of the 'sandbox' block ('endsandbox').

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the string identifier for this tag, which is 'sandbox'.
